title:
We will need to do this in three steps, since we can't have the types in both apps and server at the same
time - basically the reverse of CRM-142:

1. Temporarily rename the types in apps code and copy the types there (c3base/base/salesforce/src) under the new names.
2. When apps is green, delete the types from server code.
3. When server is green, change the type names back in apps code.
